| Category = Hamburger recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle chiles in adobo]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1–1½ [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 tsp Montreal Steak Seasoning
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] ground [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|beef chuck]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 8 slices [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], crisp cooked
* 4 slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|pepper jack cheese]]
* Hamburger buns
* [[Cookbook:Lettuce|Lettuce]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], and [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Combine mayonnaise and chipotle. Refrigerate until needed.
#Combine cayenne, salt, pepper, and steak seasoning. Set aside.
#Form meat into 4 equal patties, about ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick. Make an indentation in the center of each one and [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] with olive oil.
#Sprinkle patties on both sides with seasoning mixture. Set aside.
#Preheat a chimney starter full of charcoal in the bottom of a kettle grill. Once hot, disperse evenly around the bottom of the grill.
#Add burgers and grill, turning often, until desired doneness is achieved.
#Place a slice of cheese on each patty once it comes off the grill. Serve on buns with bacon, lettuce, tomato, and the chipotle mayonnaise.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you can't stand the heat, you may, of course, reduce the cayenne.
